captions.formal: Vehicles traverse a multi-lane urban thoroughfare lined with autumn foliage, with high-rise residential towers visible in the background under late afternoon light.
captions.sarcastic: Behold, humanity's grandest achievement: thousands of hours of collective life, spent achieving roughly the same forward motion as a brisk walk.
captions.humorous_tech: Traffic attempts a rolling deploy to production during peak hours with no staging environment and several merge conflicts already in progress.
captions.humorous_non_tech: Every driver on this road is absolutely certain their lane is the wrong one, and the proof keeps arriving one brake light at a time.

captions.formal: A small orange kitten advances along a shaded dirt path between dense green shrubs, its gaze fixed directly toward the camera.
captions.sarcastic: Truly, nature's fiercest predator has arrived, and it is absolutely determined to conquer this one very specific patch of dirt.
captions.humorous_tech: The junior dev kitten pushes straight to main with zero review, absolute confidence, and absolutely no awareness of the branch directly ahead.
captions.humorous_non_tech: The kitten approaches with the energy of a landlord who has heard you own a can opener and would like to discuss the terms immediately.

captions.formal: A woman sits at a white desk in an open-plan office, typing on a desktop computer beneath circular overhead lights, with a potted plant visible behind her.
captions.sarcastic: Truly, the modern workplace delivers endless excitement: one woman, one monitor, and the thrilling drama of whether she will blink before the spreadsheet does.
captions.humorous_tech: She is clearly debugging production in real time, fingers flying across the keyboard with the desperate energy of someone whose pager went off at 2 AM and never stopped.
captions.humorous_non_tech: She types with the fierce concentration of someone who just remembered the deadline was yesterday and the coffee machine is broken.

captions.formal: A multi-tiered waterfall descends a moss-covered rock face in a forested gorge, with mist rising from the turbulent cascade.
captions.sarcastic: Truly groundbreaking: water, having discovered gravity, continues its downward trend with absolutely no innovation whatsoever.
captions.humorous_tech: The waterfall is running a continuous deployment pipeline straight to prod with zero rollback strategy and impressive throughput.
captions.humorous_non_tech: The waterfall has been falling for thousands of years and still hasn't found the bottom, which honestly, same.

captions.formal: An aerial camera glides through a modern city skyline at twilight, passing illuminated office towers and a distinctive sail-shaped building with vertical blue lighting.
captions.sarcastic: Behold humanity's greatest achievement: thousands of lights left on in empty buildings to remind the sky we are definitely still very busy and important.
captions.humorous_tech: The drone executes a graceful production deploy across the downtown stack, gracefully rolling past the legacy monolith and the shiny new Kubernetes sail.
captions.humorous_non_tech: Every window glows with the warm light of someone who absolutely meant to leave work two hours ago but got distracted by a very important email.

captions.formal: A short video clip presents a real-world scene with people or objects in motion.
captions.sarcastic: A riveting short clip, packed with all the drama a few passing seconds can muster.
captions.humorous_tech: A brief clip that loads faster than a morning stand-up and resolves with fewer merge conflicts.
captions.humorous_non_tech: A little slice of life, captured in the few seconds before anyone thought to tidy up.

captions.formal: Pedestrians and vehicles move through a large urban intersection in alternating phases, with crowds crossing the striped walkways before halting for automotive traffic.
captions.sarcastic: Remarkable choreography: thousands of people stand perfectly still on a sidewalk, as if the asphalt itself demands their worship.
captions.humorous_tech: The intersection runs a brutal load balancer—pedestrians get a deploy window, then vehicles roll back prod with zero regression testing.
captions.humorous_non_tech: Every few minutes, the crowd plays the world's largest game of red light, green light, and everyone loses their turn to a taxi.

captions.formal: Players in athletic footwear contest a soccer ball on an artificial turf pitch at dusk, with one striker advancing toward the goal as the goalkeeper dives to intercept.
captions.sarcastic: Truly breathtaking strategy: three players sprint toward one ball while the goalkeeper heroically lies down to contemplate the sunset.
captions.humorous_tech: Two forwards execute a chaotic merge into the goal branch with zero coordination, triggering a total production outage for the goalkeeper.
captions.humorous_non_tech: Three guys run at a ball like it owes them money, while the goalkeeper chooses the classic 'lie down and hope' defense.

captions.formal: A chef tosses chopped vegetables in a frying pan over an open flame on a metal grill, sending mushrooms, onions, and peppers airborne amid rising smoke.
captions.sarcastic: Nothing says controlled environment quite like open flames licking a pan of airborne produce while someone presumably still gets dinner service out on time.
captions.humorous_tech: The vegetables are staging a chaotic hotfix directly in prod, rolling back from the pan with zero downtime and absolutely no rollback plan.
captions.humorous_non_tech: Every vegetable in that pan just remembered it left the stove on, and now they're all trying to jump out at once like a tiny produce panic drill.

captions.formal: Rain falls through sunlit tree branches, with water droplets catching light as the camera tilts upward toward the bright sky.
captions.sarcastic: Nature really outdid itself here: rain and sunshine at the same time, as if weather could not commit to a single mood.
captions.humorous_tech: The cloud is running a chaotic A/B test, simultaneously deploying rain and sunshine to production with zero rollback plan.
captions.humorous_non_tech: The sky is having an identity crisis, sending rain while the sun beams through like nothing is wrong at all.

captions.formal: A person wearing eyeglasses observes scrolling text and data visualizations reflected across the lenses in a dimly lit environment.
captions.sarcastic: Truly, the future is now: a human face, some glasses, and the revolutionary act of watching numbers pretend to mean something.
captions.humorous_tech: Senior engineer reviews the same dashboard for eleven frames straight, achieves zero latency on actually doing anything about it.
captions.humorous_non_tech: A man stares at glowing squiggles with the intensity of someone trying to remember if he left the stove on.
